title: Annotatio III §.V: Rest in Hornbeck’s judgment — no better, more august, or more perfect Confession ever made; approved politically and ecclesiastically; confirmed by joyful sacramental communion
pass_a_gloss: being about to rest thereafter in the Judgment of blessed Hornbeck concerning this Consensus, which we will always also make our own, when he says: No better or more august and more perfect Confession than this was ever made, which was approved Politically and Ecclesiastically, and which they confirmed mutually by a most joyful and illustrious Communion of sacred things.
pass_b_english: For the rest we rest in blessed Hornbeck’s judgment on this Consensus — and we will always make it ours — when he says: no better, more august, or more perfect Confession than this was ever made.
It was approved politically and ecclesiastically, and they confirmed it mutually by a most joyful and illustrious communion of the sacraments.
source_text: acquiesuri de cetero in Judicio B. Hornbeckii de hoc Consensu, quod semper & nostrum faciemus, quando: Nulla, inquit, hâc melior vel augustior & perfectior Confessio facta unquam fuit, quae Politice & Ecclesiasticè approbata, & quam jucundâ & illustri admodum Sacrorum Communione invicem confirmarunt.

rejected: confirmed in turn as a queue

notes: Hornbeck Miscel. Sacr. judgment; political/ecclesial approval; Sacrorum Communio.
